name: Comment Revision UI
description: Exposes core comment revisions through a version-history, revert and delete UI with per-comment-type permissions.
project_description:
This module takes advantage of work in progress Drupal core patches to add a revision UI for comments. Most of the code of this project was taken from the Block Content Revision UI module.

 Instructions 
 
 Apply the work from [#2880154] as patch to your project to make comment entities revisionable. 
 Run database updates 
 Apply the work from [#2350939] as patch to your project to include the generic revision UI which is used by this module. 
 Assign the appropriate user permissions. See 'Comment Revision UI' section in /admin/people/permissions . 
 Export any configuration changes if necessary
